name: @argszero/dsh-write-readback-guard
description: A host plugin for the harness's `write` and `edit` tools: after a call reports success, read the file back through the same `ctx.fs` the tool wrote through and compare it with the content the tool itself claimed (`result.value.after`). When the disk disagrees, the success is turned into a stated failure the model can act on instead of a silent one it cannot. Reported as discussion #11532: writes answering 'File created'/'updated successfully' while the file is unchanged, which the agent then reports upward as done. Fail-open by construction: an absent result, a binary or oversized file, an unreadable target and any call that already failed all pass through untouched and are counted, and a write that genuinely landed produces no output at all. Zero runtime dependencies; it changes no tool, no schema and no file.
